author: Karl Rock
description:
I was told NOT to come here. I'm driving through one of Pakistan's most dangerous kidnapping regions, where armed bandits operate and both the UK and New Zealand governments warn against travelling here. But I'm about to drive straight through it, stopping at restaurants, petrol stations, markets and even a hotel along the way.

Instead of simply driving through, I wanted to see what this region is actually like.

So I got in a car with a local driver who speaks Sindhi and knows the roads, and drove through what I call Pakistan's "kidnapping highway" on the way to Larkana and, eventually, Mohenjo Daro.

Along the way, I explain why this region has such a dangerous reputation, how kidnappings have affected the area, why police escorts have been used on the highway, and some of the precautions I took while travelling through Sindh past Nawabshah.

But then something surprising happens.

Despite everything I'd just told you about the risks, we actually start stopping.

title: My Government Told Me NOT to Come Here… So I Did!
